title: Dot Matrix
style: Everything is made of dots on one grid: a month calendar where days fill as dots, numerals and words rendered as dot-matrix lettering, a clock whose hands are dot trails, a progress ring of dots. Dots grow, shrink and change colour; nothing else is drawn. Captions are serif word ladders (kit captions.ts): short stacks of mixed sizes, one key word in the accent italic, set beside the action and arriving word by word.
learnsFrom: Founder explainer reels (Instagram, @gregisenberg's team): a calendar of dots filling up to show time passing, dot-grid lettering.

story.what: hook: a grid of faint dots; a wave of dots lights up and spells 'WEEK' in dot-matrix
the dots form a month; days fill one by one as meetings (amber), quickly crowding the grid
the crowded days pulse and empty; a few blue focus blocks remain; caption 'take back the week'
the dots swirl into a clock face; the hour hand trails dots and stops on 3
the dots spell 'ORIEL' then settle into a single ring; caption 'one hour, found'

sizes: Vertical makes the grid taller: the month runs as two stacked blocks and the lettering is set on two lines.
sound: beatScore soft at 120 bpm with a soft tick per filled day (thinned so it never buzzes), a hit when the clock stops and the sign-off.
teaches: One primitive, repeated, can be the whole language: decide the grid first and let every shape emerge from it.

portable.fonts: none for the dot lettering (draw it on the grid); Instrument Serif and Instrument Serif Italic for captions
